entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A giant planeswalker with warrior-druid abilities and an affinity with beasts, cursed by the Chain Veil, later enthralled by Oko and freed on Eldraine.

entities.name: Raklan
entities.description: Garruk's father, a taskmage who taught him his first spell and was killed by men of Lord Faldus.

entities.name: Lord Faldus
entities.description: A lord whose Sheriff came to conscript young Garruk into his army.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: An ageless necromancer and planeswalker who used the Chain Veil to curse Garruk.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact in an Onakke temple whose black magic cursed Garruk and turned him into a planeswalker hunter.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind-mage planeswalker who helped Garruk and later died in the Echoverse after splintering his personality.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A fey planeswalker on Eldraine who enthralled Garruk as a bodyguard called Dog.

entities.name: Vronos
entities.description: A planeswalker and elite inquisitor sent to bring Garruk to Avacyn, killed by Garruk who took his mask.

entities.name: Icy
entities.description: An unnamed ice-wielding planeswalker hired by Vronos to bring Garruk to Avacyn, whom Garruk beheaded.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel of Innistrad whose Cursemute spell temporarily freed Garruk of the curse.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A high-ranking church officer on Innistrad who trapped and drugged Garruk.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: One of the Kenrith twins, who noted Garruk was deadly but not a threat.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: One of the Kenrith twins, who removed Garruk's hedron and risked his life to save him from the river.

entities.name: Cerise
entities.description: A companion of the twins, injured by Garruk, who removed the hedron.

entities.name: Cado
entities.description: A prisoner guarded by Garruk whose griffin Garruk was forced to kill.

entities.name: Ayara
entities.description: An elven queen whose form Oko took to shoot the stag.

entities.name: Syr Ginger
entities.description: A food golem of Castle Ardenvale who became Garruk's mortal enemy.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who asked Garruk to help stop Jace.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who asked Garruk to help stop Jace.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who accompanied Garruk into the Echoverse and stabbed the Theorist in the back.

entities.name: Theorist
entities.description: The cold and determined aspect of Jace that locked the others in mental prisons and began a ritual to overwrite the Multiverse.

entities.name: Detective
entities.description: A selfless aspect of Jace who helped the planeswalkers plan against the Theorist.

entities.name: Clean Slate
entities.description: An aspect of Jace as a child enduring abuse, freed by Garruk's empathy and hosted in his mind.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: Jace's abusive mentor.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: An alternate reality that Jace's ritual sought to bind to the Multiverse, in which alternate versions of the planeswalkers exist.

entities.name: Echoverse Garruk
entities.description: An alternate Garruk who donned the Chain Veil willingly and became a merciless butcher.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon who told the Echoverse Garruk the Chain Veil would bind the beast inside him.

entities.name: Worldslayer
entities.description: A demon the curse was prophesied to transform Garruk into, which would have destroyed Shandalar.

entities.name: Cauldron of Eternity
entities.description: The chalice that pulled the curse from Garruk on Eldraine.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker who kept Garruk out of the Ravnica war.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Garruk's first planeswalk destination and the plane of the Onakke temple and Chain Veil.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A world-spanning metropolis where Garruk confronted Jace.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Garruk tracked Liliana and was briefly freed by the Cursemute.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane where Oko enthralled Garruk and where he was freed.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A plane of untamed wilds where Garruk settled.

entities.name: Kylem
entities.description: A place the twins fled to, where Garruk followed them.

entities.name: Wild Hunt
entities.description: The hunting elves who surrounded the High King as a stag.

events.summary: As a boy Garruk is told by his father Raklan to hide in the forest after a Sheriff of Lord Faldus comes to conscript him.
events.quote: Raklan told Garruk to run and hide in the forest until he told him that it was safe to return.

events.summary: Years later Garruk calls a wurm that devours the Sheriff and takes his helm.
events.quote: Garruk had planned for that treachery and called a wurm that devoured the Sheriff.

events.summary: Garruk's spark ignites and he planeswalks for the first time, to Shandalar.
events.quote: his first planeswalk was to Shandalar

events.summary: Garruk hunts the Ursoth, then rages at Liliana for killing one of his beasts and assaults her in an Onakke temple.
events.quote: he flew into a rage and tracked her down, assaulting her in an ancient Onakke temple

events.summary: Liliana uses the Chain Veil to overpower and curse Garruk.
events.quote: Liliana overpowered him with a surge of black magic that cursed him

events.summary: Garruk seeks a cure on Ravnica and overpowers Jace before coming to his senses, then learns Liliana's last location.
events.quote: Jace told him her last known location

events.summary: Garruk tracks Liliana to Innistrad but her ghouls let her escape, and the curse overtakes him.
events.quote: He crossed her path once in Nephalia , but was beset by her ghouls.

events.summary: Avacyn's Cursemute dulls the Chain Veil's influence and temporarily frees Garruk, who chooses to keep tracking Liliana.
events.quote: the curse was pushed into remission, temporarily freeing Garruk

events.summary: Odric traps and drugs Garruk to take him to trial before Avacyn, but Garruk escapes enraged.
events.quote: Garruk became enraged and escaped Odric and his Riders.

events.summary: Garruk comes to see all planeswalkers as prey and kills Vronos, taking his mask as a trophy.
events.quote: Vronos was quickly dispatched after a brief and disjointed clash.

events.summary: A suppression Hedron stops Garruk's transformation into the Worldslayer demon in the Onakke Catacomb.
events.quote: a suppression Hedron was used to stop Garruk's transformation into a demon

events.summary: Jace appears to Garruk disguised as Liliana; the ruse fails and Garruk warns him off.
events.quote: Masking himself as Liliana, Jace once more appeared before Garruk.

events.summary: Garruk beheads the ice-wielding planeswalker Icy, who had been hired by Vronos.
events.quote: Garruk decapitated him, noting his slowness

events.summary: Bolas arranges to keep Garruk out of the war on Ravnica.
events.quote: he devised a way to keep Garruk out of the war

events.summary: Oko traps and mesmerizes Garruk, turning him into a slave bodyguard called Dog.
events.quote: Oko mesmerized Garruk, turning him into a slave bodyguard called Dog.

events.summary: At Oko's behest Garruk saves the Kenrith twins from Redcaps and kills the High King's guards before Oko kidnaps the king.
events.quote: Garruk killed the guards of the High King at Oko's behest

events.summary: Garruk guards the prisoners while Oko prepares to have the High King killed as a stag.
events.quote: he was left to guard the prisoners

events.summary: Will removes the hedron from Garruk; the curse runs wild and Garruk rampages, injuring Cerise and killing Cado's corrupted griffin.
events.quote: As the hedron was removed from Garruk, the curse ran wild, driving him into a frenzy.

events.summary: Garruk is attacked by an abomination while crossing a river in the Wilds and kills it.
events.quote: he wrestled with the beast until he snapped its spine

events.summary: Garruk falls into the river and sinks; Will dives in to save him and pulls him into a chalice.
events.quote: Will barely reached the surface, pulling the man into the large chalice

events.summary: The chalice pulls the curse from Garruk and gives him life; he carries Will to shore.
events.quote: the chalice had forcibly pulled the curse from his form

events.summary: Garruk joins the twins in chasing the Wild Hunt to save their father, and Oko, disguised as Ayara, shoots the stag.
events.quote: Oko took the form of the elven queen Ayara and shot the stag in the chest with an arrow.

events.summary: Garruk tries to stop Oko but hesitates at Rowan's protest and Oko planeswalks away.
events.quote: all the time the man needed to planeswalk away to freedom

events.summary: Garruk gives the twins' parents his word to find and watch over them, and leaves Eldraine.
events.quote: "They helped me. I will help them"

events.summary: Garruk follows the twins to Kylem and leaves them alone once they are safe.
events.quote: Garruk followed Rowan and Will to Kylem .

events.summary: Chandra and Ajani recruit Garruk on Muraganda to help stop Jace's plot to erase the Multiverse.
events.quote: Garruk agreed to help

events.summary: Garruk, Chandra, Ajani and Vraska enter the Echoverse and fail to reason with Jace; the planeswalkers are thrown into mental prisons.
events.quote: The planeswalkers made an initial attempt to reason with Jace, but it failed.

events.summary: Garruk's empathy frees the Clean Slate, an aspect of Jace as an abused child, which he hosts in his mind.
events.quote: He hosted the Clean Slate in his mind as the allies moved forward.

events.summary: The Theorist banishes Garruk into mental space with his accursed counterpart, but Vraska finds and frees them.
events.quote: he banished Garruk back into mental space alongside his accursed counterpart

events.summary: Vraska stabs the Theorist in the back and Jace's mind is reunited, but he dies peacefully, thanking Garruk.
events.quote: Jace's mind was reunited, but he was dying.

events.summary: Garruk attacks Liliana as they flee the collapsing Echoverse, but she talks him down, and he leaves after learning she did not curse Rowan.
events.quote: Liliana managed to talk him down

relations.note: She cursed him with the Chain Veil, and he hunted her for it.
relations.quote: Liliana overpowered him with a surge of black magic that cursed him
Garruk lived on a farm with his father - a taskmage named Raklan .

relations.note: He quickly dispatched Vronos and took his mask.
relations.quote: Vronos was quickly dispatched after a brief and disjointed clash.
Garruk decapitated him, noting his slowness

relations.note: Oko enthralled Garruk, who later wanted to kill him.
relations.quote: He desired to follow Oko and kill the man for what he had done to him

relations.note: Garruk was enthralled as Oko's slave bodyguard.
relations.quote: turning him into a slave bodyguard called Dog

relations.note: Will risked his life to save Garruk from the river.
relations.quote: the memories of Will risking his own life trying to pull him from the river

relations.note: He abused Jace as a child.
relations.quote: enduring the abuse of his mentor Alhammarret

relations.note: She stabbed Jace's Theorist aspect in the back so the other aspects could overpower him.
relations.quote: which allowed Vraska an opening to stab him in the back

relations.note: Garruk made a mortal enemy of the food golem.
relations.quote: he made a mortal enemy of the food golem Syr Ginger

relations.note: He agreed to help Chandra and Ajani stop Jace.
relations.quote: he accompanied the two of them and Vraska into the Echoverse
